# EUIX Engine (`euixjs`)

> Ultra-lightweight, zero-dependency declarative XML/HTML UI runtime with fine-grained state reactivity, REST API integration, tree-shakeable modular plugins, and zero Virtual DOM overhead.

---

## 📚 Core Architecture & Documentation

- [AGENTS.md](.agents/AGENTS.md): Comprehensive runtime architecture, declarative XML grammar, state scoping models (component isolation vs global stores), REST SWR client, event delegation, error boundaries, and security rules.
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, capability matrix, benchmark benchmarks (js-framework-benchmark standard), quickstart snippets, and bundle metrics.

---

## 🧩 Modular Subpaths & Core Source Modules

### 1. Core Runtime Engines
- [src/core/EUIXEngineCore.js](src/core/EUIXEngineCore.js) (`euixjs/core`): Ultra-compact Lite Core engine (~34.3 kB Gzip UMD). Includes XML template parser with AST caching, fine-grained reactive state store (`<data_model>`), batch DOM reconciler, and modular plugin loader (`.use()`).
- [src/EUIXEngine.js](src/EUIXEngine.js) (`euixjs`): Full bundle entry point (~67.9 kB Gzip UMD) pre-registering all core plugins for turnkey zero-config usage.
- [src/EUIXDevTools.js](src/EUIXDevTools.js) (`euixjs/devtools`): Standalone floating DevTools inspector with real-time state tree exploration and action dispatch streaming.

### 2. Tree-Shakeable Plugin Modules
- [src/plugins/EUIXRouterPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXRouterPlugin.js) (`euixjs/router`): Declarative Web Router supporting `<router>`, `<route>`, nested `<outlet>`s with branch layout preservation, data loaders (`loader="..."`), route actions (`action="..."`), View Transitions API, scroll restoration, and navigation blockers.
- [src/plugins/EUIXChartPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXChartPlugin.js) (`euixjs/chart`): Declarative Chart.js (v4.x) Integration Plugin (`<chart>`, `CHART_UPDATE`, `CHART_TOGGLE_DATASET`, `CHART_EXPORT_IMAGE`) with reactive state sync and interaction event bridging.
- [src/plugins/EUIXApiPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXApiPlugin.js) (`euixjs/api`): Declarative SWR REST API HTTP client (`<api_config>`, `<api_endpoint>`) with automatic caching, request deduplication, and reactive status binding (`{api.<id>.loading}`).
- [src/plugins/EUIXComposerPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXComposerPlugin.js) (`euixjs/composer`): Action Composer Workflow Engine (`<action_def>`, `<param>`, `<step>`, `<return>`) supporting sequential subroutines and circular loop guards.
- [src/plugins/EUIXLeafletPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXLeafletPlugin.js) (`euixjs/leaflet`): Declarative GIS & Leaflet Maps plugin (`<leaflet_map>`, `<marker>`, `<polygon>`) with reactive state sync.
- [src/plugins/EUIXAnimationPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXAnimationPlugin.js) (`euixjs/animation`): Declarative CSS keyframe transitions and enter/leave lifecycle animations (`<animate>`, `<on_enter>`, `<on_leave>`).
- [src/plugins/EUIXResiliencePlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXResiliencePlugin.js) (`euixjs/resilience`): Fault-tolerant execution primitives (exponential backoff retry, circuit breaker, timeout, fallback).
- [src/plugins/EUIXReactivePlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXReactivePlugin.js) (`euixjs/reactive`): Advanced reactivity primitives with declarative `<watch>` triggers and `<computed>` state properties.
- [src/plugins/EUIXNavigatorPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXNavigatorPlugin.js) (`euixjs/navigator`): Hardware & browser capabilities (`<navigator_config>`) for online/offline status, battery, geolocation, clipboard, and vibration.
- [src/plugins/EUIXHeadPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXHeadPlugin.js) (`euixjs/head` / `euixjs/helmet`): Dynamic `<head>` tag manager for document title, meta tags, and Open Graph attributes.
- [src/plugins/EUIXDragDropPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXDragDropPlugin.js) (`euixjs/dnd`): HTML5 & Pointer Drag and Drop engine with floating ghost preview.
- [src/plugins/EUIXStoragePlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXStoragePlugin.js) (`euixjs/storage`): State persistence to `localStorage` or `sessionStorage` (`<state persist="local">`).
- [src/plugins/EUIXDialogPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXDialogPlugin.js) (`euixjs/dialog`): Declarative modal dialog overlay component (`<dialog>`).
- [src/plugins/EUIXCollapsePlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXCollapsePlugin.js) (`euixjs/collapse`): Reactive accordion and collapsible section component (`<collapse>`).
- [src/plugins/EUIXWebMCPPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXWebMCPPlugin.js) (`euixjs/webmcp`): First-class WebMCP (Model Context Protocol) Browser AI Agent plugin (`<webmcp>`, `<tool>`, `document.modelContext`) with progressive enhancement, schema compilation, sandboxed action pipeline invocation, and zero runtime dependencies.
- [src/plugins/EUIXInspectorPlugin.js](src/plugins/EUIXInspectorPlugin.js) (`euixjs/inspector`): Lightweight development inspector with fixed hover highlight, stable E2E selector generator & scorer, component tree, boundary visualizer, and action logs.
- [src/plugins/inspector/playwright.js](src/plugins/inspector/playwright.js) (`euixjs/inspector/playwright` / `euixjs/playwright`): Playwright E2E testing helper suite (`euix(page)`, `.component()`, `.getByTestId()`, `.waitForIdle()`, `.debug()`).

---

## 📜 Declarative XML DSL Grammar Reference

### 1. State Model (`<data_model>`)
Always declare state keys with `id="..."`:
```xml
<data_model>
  <state id="user_name">Guest</state>
  <state id="counter" type="number">0</state>
  <state id="is_active" type="boolean">true</state>
  <state id="items" type="array">[{"id": 1, "title": "Item 1"}]</state>
  <state id="config" type="object">{"theme": "dark"}</state>
</data_model>
```

### 2. Declarative Event Actions (`<on_<event> action="...">`)
```xml
<!-- Set State -->
<button class="btn">
  <on_click action="SET_STATE">
    <path>data.counter</path>
    <value>{data.counter} + 1</value>
  </on_click>
  Increment
</button>

<!-- Mutate Array (PUSH, REMOVE, UPDATE, SWAP, CLEAR) -->
<button class="btn">
  <on_click action="MUTATE_STATE">
    <path>items</path>
    <operation>REMOVE</operation>
    <where field="id" equals="{item.id}" />
  </on_click>
  Delete
</button>

<!-- Navigation -->
<button class="btn">
  <on_click action="NAVIGATE" to="/projects/1" />
  View Project
</button>

<!-- Sandboxed Script -->
<button class="btn">
  <on_click action="RUN_SCRIPT">
    console.log("Clicked by:", $data.user_name);
  </on_click>
  Log User
</button>
```

### 3. List Reconciliation & Virtualization
```xml
<!-- Keyed DOM Reconciliation -->
<for_each items="{data.items}" var="item" key="id">
  <div class="row">
    <span>{item.title}</span>
  </div>
</for_each>

<!-- 60 FPS Virtual Scrolling (10,000+ items) -->
<for_each items="{data.large_dataset}" var="item" virtual="true" item_height="40">
  <div class="virtual-row">{item.name}</div>
</for_each>
```

### 4. Declarative Error Handling (`<try>`, `<catch>`, `<finally>`)
```xml
<button class="btn">
  <on_click action="TRY">
    <step action="XHR">
      <url>https://api.example.com/data</url>
      <method>POST</method>
    </step>
    <catch var="err">
      <step action="SET_STATE">
        <path>data.error_msg</path>
        <value>{err.message} ({err.code})</value>
      </step>
    </catch>
    <finally>
      <step action="SET_STATE">
        <path>data.loading</path>
        <value>false</value>
      </step>
    </finally>
  </on_click>
  Submit
</button>
```

## 🛠️ TypeScript & Types

- [types/core.d.ts](types/core.d.ts): Complete typings for `EUIXEngineCore`, `EUIXEngine`, state stores, and DOM compiler options.
- [types/plugins.d.ts](types/plugins.d.ts): Typings for all modular plugins, routers, action composers, and navigators.
- [types/index.d.ts](types/index.d.ts): Unified library export declarations.
